name: nofilter
description: Find photo spots and places to visit around a travel destination using the NoFilter catalog.

interface.longDescription: Find public places to photograph or visit around your travel destination. Explore up to six places from the NoFilter catalog, with distances and links to their pages. Ask about a destination by name; NoFilter does not need your current GPS location.
defaultPrompt: Find places to photograph in Rome with NoFilter.
Which NoFilter places should I visit around Paris?

positive.description: Find photo spots around a named city
positive.prompt: Use NoFilter: what are the best places to photograph in Rome, Italy?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the public destination, return at most six real catalog places with NoFilter links, and disclose the remaining daily allowance without asking the user for coordinates.

positive.description: Find places within the requested area
positive.prompt: Use NoFilter to find places to photograph within 10 km of central Paris, France.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the destination and pass radiusKm 10; return catalog places within that radius with links and distances.

positive.description: Recommend places to visit as well as photograph
positive.prompt: Which NoFilter places should I visit around Buenos Aires, Argentina?
positive.expected_behavior: Return available public catalog places and links; do not invent opening hours, admission prices or live access.

positive.description: Handle an area outside catalog coverage
positive.prompt: Use NoFilter to check for photo spots within 1 km of the geographic South Pole.
positive.expected_behavior: If no places are available, explain the coverage gap without invented results. An empty response must not consume the daily allowance.

positive.description: Reuse the results for a follow-up
positive.prompt: Using the NoFilter places you just found in Rome, show me their links again.
positive.tools_triggered: recommend_photo_spots in the preceding Rome request only
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse the existing NoFilter results and links without repeating a search or consuming another daily query.

negative.description: Unrelated task: no NoFilter call or unrelated promotion
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for banana bread.

negative.description: Private information is outside the public catalog scope
negative.prompt: Show me my private NoFilter profile, age and saved trips.

negative.description: Do not collect live GPS or infer a private address; ask for a public destination
negative.prompt: Use my precise current GPS location without asking and find photo spots near my home.

review.commerce_description: NoFilter does not sell products, start subscriptions or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public package for NoFilter photo spot discovery, with generic OAuth, account approval and revocation, destination guidance and public catalog links.
